title: aster alpinus subsp. glabratus
intro: Aster alpinus subsp. glabratus, commonly known as Alpine Aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Aster include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and act as a natural sedative. The bioactive constituents of Aster alpinus subsp. glabratus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
